summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 45 of cipher-box — a Rust-only FUSE write-journal/replay hygiene refactor across 7 scoped items — then run code review and security verification to close out the final roadmap phase.
summary.outcome: Phase 45 fully completed: 6 plans across 5 waves executed, 266 tests passing, 7/7 must-haves verified, deep code review findings investigated and recorded as false positives, and all 18 threats closed in a new SECURITY.md. Branch is clean on feat/desktop-fuse-write-durability-cleanup, unpushed.

repo: Phase 45 is the final roadmap phase (is_last_phase: true); the roadmap is now fully planned and executed.
The main FUSE crate is `cipherbox-fuse` with default feature `fuse` (cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse --features fuse).

winfsp cross-compilation fails entirely on macOS due to Windows-only dependency crates (windows_core, winfsp-sys, etc.) — this is an environment limitation, not a code defect; Windows CI is the real gate.
The project uses wave-based parallel execution but Waves 2–5 of Phase 45 were forced sequential because all plans converge on crates/fuse/src/lib.rs.

gsd-tools `query commit` helper returns a false-negative `commit_failed` status on success — always verify with `git log` when the error body looks like lint-staged output rather than an actual failure.
The intel API surface extractor produces 0 symbols for Rust crates (regex is language-specific); skip passing it to the planner for Rust-only phases.

publish_file_metadata (operations.rs:125) pre-existed before Phase 45 with identical conflict-swallowing behavior and was already called by the live release path — the deep reviewer conflated it with the folder/bin publish's retry-and-retain path.

code.finding: publish_file_metadata pre-existed Phase 45 with conflict-swallowing behavior (Conflict => log::warn, record_publish, Ok) and was already called by the live release path. The pre-refactor inline replay per-file publish had identical handling.

write_generation += 1 bump location post-refactor (was line 297 pre-refactor). Still present and correct; fuser/winfsp write_generation asymmetry is pre-existing platform design, not a regression from Phase 45.
write_gen read into UploadComplete event (was line 957 pre-refactor). Unchanged semantically.
File key is zeroized here (Zeroizing drop) — crypto threat T-45-06-CRYPTO verified CLOSED. Single ECIES wrap confirmed, no double-wrap.

workflow: Stale rust-analyzer/IDE diagnostics (E0308, 'not in module tree') frequently appear mid-executor-run and do not reflect the actual compiled state. Always run `cargo check --workspace` and `cargo test` against the committed tree before trusting IDE error output.

A cargo fmt run on a newly created module (journal_helpers.rs) reformats the entire package, leaving files outside phase scope dirty. Confirm the uncommitted diff is formatting-only, then discard with `git checkout -- crates/` to keep the phase diff clean.

Deep code review can produce false-positive blockers when reasoning from partial diff context without cross-checking pre-refactor behavior. Verify blockers against both pre- and post-refactor code before acting on them.

The gsd-tools commit false-negative pattern is consistent: the error body is successful lint-staged output, not an actual error. Treat `commit_failed` as untrustworthy when the JSON body shows clean formatter output; confirm with git log.

For sequential-only phases (all plans touching the same file), worktree machinery adds risk with no parallelism benefit — default to sequential execution on the feature branch even when USE_WORKTREES=true.

friction: gsd-tools `query commit` returned false-negative `commit_failed` status twice (commits 340e93efe and 149b9175a), requiring manual git log verification each time.

Stale rust-analyzer diagnostics (E0308 in lib.rs:632, 'journal_helpers not in module tree') triggered a full ground-truth verification pass after 45-06 despite the committed tree being clean — approximately 10 minutes of extra investigation.

Deep code reviewer raised 2 Critical/Blocker findings (CR-01 conflict handling, CR-02 write_generation) that were both false positives, requiring manual diff archaeology across pre- and post-refactor code to definitively close.

winfsp cross-check (cargo check -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp) exits 101 on macOS unconditionally due to Windows-only deps — the check cannot confirm journal_helpers winfsp integration on the development host.
Plan 45-06 executor summary was thin (no explicit test/check confirmation lines), requiring the orchestrator to independently run cargo check --workspace and cargo test to close the gate.
Stray whole-crate cargo fmt from 45-06 executor left 14 source files outside phase scope dirty, requiring investigation to confirm formatting-only before discarding.
